question: Where does the self sign rest?
premises: This self sign rests in supreme unmanifest.
That unmanifest is full of Shiva-power atom nature.
This discussion is not about unsurpassed abode.
inference: The self sign rests in the supreme unmanifest full of Shiva-power nature.
plain_english: By that, this self sign rests in the supreme unmanifest, full of Shiva-power atom nature; this discussion is not about the unsurpassed abode.
